title: The prompt is a generic 'audit and fix thoroughly' instruction, but the only verifier compares font color (mode 'font_color') cell by cell over thousands of cells in 17 sheets. The agent is never told that color coding is what gets graded, nor which cells should get which color.
evidence: verifications[0].parameters.mode='font_color'; answer_position spans 'Cover'!C2:J10 through 'PTs'!A5:I20, including raw Capital IQ sheets (BS, BS Ann, IS Q, CFS Q, etc.). The prompt only mentions 'inconsistent formatting or naming conventions' among many error types.
confirmation: The verifier is in font_color mode and golden differs from input only in font colors, while the prompt is the generic audit text. The scheme is not even consistent: Operating Model cross-sheet links J4:S4/J14:S14 become green, but WACC!C8 ='Comps + Beta'!C33 becomes black and Supporting Schedules AD
